video.title: Los Angeles Lakers Fantasy Basketball Preview [26/27 NBA Season]

summary: Josh Lloyd previews the Lakers for fantasy after LeBron James and most of last season's roster left. Luka Doncic is a pick 3 or 4 player and should never go at 2. Austin Reaves is his top target. He projects Reaves around picks 15 to 18 and says Reaves could finish in the first round, so ESPN's rank of 50 and an ADP of 39 are far too low. Walker Kessler is his biggest fade: he would not draft him in the top 50 because he doubts last season's jumps in threes, steals, assists and free throws will carry over. Quentin Grimes is his favorite late flyer, partly as a handcuff to Doncic and Reaves. Sandro Mamukelashvili is a deep-league stash in case Kessler gets hurt. The rest of the roster is a crowd of role players best suited to be 8th to 11th men, so the rotation is unclear, and the team has a below-average playoff schedule and the second most back-to-backs in the league.
